scenes.title: Your characters
scenes.narration: This is AstraCore's fictional screenshot tour, with no live pilot data. On your own profile, connect each EVE character separately, review the permissions, and check planetary skills and colony slots.

scenes.title: Your operating area
scenes.narration: Choose your goal and login routine, then confirm an operating area in guided setup. Use the detailed Area page to fine tune constellations and the drop off. Demo Harbour is entirely fictional.

scenes.title: A routine that fits
scenes.narration: Balance income against the time you spend on upkeep. Review login frequency, travel, products and selling. These demo comparisons use fixed illustrative figures. They do not optimize the fictional crew or save changes.

scenes.title: Check assumptions
scenes.narration: Review production, time, hauling and assumptions before building. Yield is estimated, while prices, order depth and demand can change. This summary has no colony allocation or templates. It is not an executable plan.

scenes.title: Your next action
scenes.narration: After building, Operate highlights your next action, such as a restart, pickup or restock. Colony data updates after you open the colony in EVE. Check freshness, then restart extractors and move cargo yourself.

scenes.title: Fly and sell yourself
scenes.narration: Check routes, docking access, cargo capacity and provider terms before hauling or selling. Real plans refer to DalShooth's templates. EVE Online belongs to CCP. Built by capsuleers and contributors, AstraCore is independent. Estimates are not guaranteed earnings.
